content.short: Blinq is a derivatives layer for prediction markets offering leverage on event outcomes.
content.description: Blinq adds up to five times leverage to prediction market positions, settled in USDC. Barriers are listed on a central limit order book as knock-in and knock-out contracts written against probability feeds, and margin is crossed across a trader's positions with pooled LP credit behind it. Polymarket markets can be traded through this layer, alongside live markets in crypto, macro, sports and global events. Short-dated products include five-minute up or down markets on BTC, ETH and SOL.
content.meta: Take leveraged positions on prediction market outcomes instead of posting the full notional.
